name: triage_one_line_classification
description: Mirrors Health Event Router's Build Triage Prompt exactly (n8n, homelab#571 / D-027): a bare one-line data string, no system prompt, asking for exactly one of three enum tokens. This role runs every 5 minutes on the small-CUDA lane, currently served by llama3.2:1b -- latency matters as much as correctness. Lets any small-lane candidate be measured on this exact prompt shape before a swap, rather than only on manifest-generation-style tasks.
